'''Herman Valentiner''' (8 May 1850 – 17 September 1913) was a Danish [[mathematician]] who introduced the [[Valentiner group]] in 1889.<ref>{{Citation | last1=Valentiner | first1=H. | title=De endelige Transformations-gruppers Theori | url=https://archive.org/details/deendeligetrans00valegoog | publisher=Bianco Lunos | language=Danish | year=1889 | journal=Videnkabernes Selskabs Skrifter | volume=6}}.</ref>

Valentiner earned his [[Ph.D.]] in 1881 from the [[University of Copenhagen]] with a thesis on [[space curves]], and took a teaching position. However, soon afterwards he moved to a Danish [[life insurance]] company.<ref>{{citation
 |jfm=44.0034.07 
 |title=Nécrologie. H. Valentiner 
 |language=French 
 |year=1913 
 |journal=L'Enseignement Mathématique 
 |volume=15 
 |page=513 
 |url=http://retro.seals.ch/digbib/view?rid=ensmat-001:1913:15::828&id=hitlist 
 |url-status=dead 
 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120406171514/http://retro.seals.ch/digbib/view?rid=ensmat-001%3A1913%3A15%3A%3A828&id=hitlist 
 |archivedate=2012-04-06 
}}.</ref>
